references.text: Ahiezer, son of Ammishaddai, is again mentioned as the leader of the camp of Dan on the north side of the tabernacle.
Ahiezer, son of Ammishaddai, brings his offering as the prince of the tribe of Dan at the dedication of the altar.
Ahiezer, son of Ammishaddai, leads the people of Dan when they break camp from the encampment.
Dan was a son of Jacob through Bilhah, Rachel's servant. Here the origin of the tribe of Dan is explained.
